sheet.createDescription: Create a new CEL-based routing rule for intelligent request routing
sheet.enableRuleDescription: Rule will be active and applied to matching requests
sheet.chainRuleDescription: After this rule matches, re-evaluate routing rules using the resolved provider/model as the new context. Useful for composing rules, e.g. normalize a model alias first, then route based on the canonical name.
sheet.priorityHint: Lower numbers = higher priority (0 is highest)
sheet.ruleBuilderDescription: Build conditions to determine when this rule should apply. Leave empty to apply this rule to all requests.
sheet.limitsNote: Note: Ensure token limits, request limits, and budget are configured in <1>Model Providers → Configurations → {provider} → Governance</1> (provider-level) or <3>Model Providers → Budgets & Limits</3> section (model-level) before using them in routing rules.
sheet.targetsHint: Weights must sum to 1. Leave provider or model empty to use the incoming request value.
sheet.fallbacksHint: Provider is required, but model is optional. Leave model empty to use the incoming request value.
sheet.fallbackOrderHint: Fallbacks will be used in the order they are defined
sheet.targetsRequired: At least one routing target is required
sheet.targetWeightError: Each target weight must be greater than 0
sheet.weightSumError: Target weights must sum to 1, current total: {{total}}

tree.title: Routing Tree
tree.staticChainTooltip: Re-entry point is fully proven by static analysis; every condition on the path evaluated to a known value.
tree.dynamicChainTooltip: Re-entry point is a conditional; one or more conditions on the path are not fully evaluated at build time.
